description: Scheduled macroeconomic data releases (CPI, FOMC, jobs, GDP, etc.) from the last ~2 days through the next 7 days. Optionally set 'min_importance' (1-3, default 2) to filter out low-impact releases.

min_importance.description: Minimum importance level to include: 1 (all), 2 (medium+), 3 (high only). Defaults to 2.
